name: Miss Read: The Berlin Art Book Fair & Festival 2026
description: Miss Read returns for its 2026 edition at silent green, Berlin's multidisciplinary cultural venue. The fair is focused on independent publishing and artist books, featuring exhibitors with ongoing publishing practices. It celebrates bibliodiversity and community, showcasing international publishers and artists from various countries. The three-day event includes openings, performances, readings, and discussions, making it a key gathering point for the independent publishing world. A pre-fair takes place from June 23–25, expanding the festival experience across the week.
